description: This file contains benchmark code for internal hash set implementations in the Abseil library, including policies for integers and strings, and various benchmark functions for measuring performance of hash set operations.

classes.name: RawHashSetTestOnlyAccess
classes.description: Provides access to internal slots of hash set containers for testing purposes.

classes.name: IntPolicy
classes.description: Defines policies for handling integer keys and slots in hash set.

classes.name: StringPolicy
classes.description: Defines policies for handling string keys and slots in hash set, including construction, destruction, transfer, and element access.

classes.name: StringHash
classes.description: Hash function for string views, marked as transparent.

classes.name: StringEq
classes.description: Equality comparator for string views, marked as transparent.

classes.name: StringTable
classes.description: Hash set implementation for string keys.

classes.name: IntTable
classes.description: Hash set implementation for integer keys.

methods.name: BM_CacheInSteadyState
methods.description: Benchmark for cache behavior in hash set.

methods.name: CacheInSteadyStateArgs
methods.description: Sets arguments for cache benchmark.

methods.name: BM_EndComparison
methods.description: Benchmark for comparing hash set iterators.

methods.name: BM_Iteration
methods.description: Benchmark for iterating over hash set.

methods.name: BM_CopyCtorSparseInt
methods.description: Benchmark for copy construction of sparse integer hash set.

methods.name: BM_CopyCtorInt
methods.description: Benchmark for copy construction of integer hash set.

methods.name: BM_CopyCtorString
methods.description: Benchmark for copy construction of string hash set.

methods.name: BM_CopyAssign
methods.description: Benchmark for copy assignment of hash set.

methods.name: BM_RangeCtor
methods.description: Benchmark for range constructor of hash set.

methods.name: BM_NoOpReserveIntTable
methods.description: Benchmark for reserving capacity in integer hash set without reallocation.

methods.name: BM_NoOpReserveStringTable
methods.description: Benchmark for reserving capacity in string hash set without reallocation.

methods.name: BM_ReserveIntTable
methods.description: Benchmark for reserving capacity in integer hash set with actual reallocation.

methods.name: BM_ReserveStringTable
methods.description: Benchmark for reserving capacity in string hash set with actual reallocation.

methods.name: Iota
methods.description: Fills a range with sequential values, used for benchmarking.

methods.name: BM_Group_Match
methods.description: Benchmark for group matching operation.

methods.name: BM_Group_MaskEmpty
methods.description: Benchmark for group mask empty operation.

methods.name: BM_Group_MaskEmptyOrDeleted
methods.description: Benchmark for group mask empty or deleted operation.

methods.name: BM_Group_CountLeadingEmptyOrDeleted
methods.description: Benchmark for counting leading empty or deleted entries in group.

methods.name: BM_Group_MatchFirstEmptyOrDeleted
methods.description: Benchmark for matching first empty or deleted entry in group.

methods.name: BM_DropDeletes
methods.description: Benchmark for converting deleted slots to empty in hash table.

methods.name: BM_Resize
methods.description: Benchmark for resizing hash table.
